title: Café site: structure + styles (index.html, styles.css)
desc: Child of the café epic. Deliverable: the page skeleton and the visual system in projects/cafe-site/index.html + styles.css. Define the elements app.js will fill: a <ul id=menu> for items, a contact block, a header. ACCEPTANCE: semantic HTML5 (header/main/section/footer); CSS custom properties for the palette; responsive with one breakpoint (<=640px); no external assets (inline SVG only);  returns no external URLs; a smoke check that python3 -c 'import html.parser; html.parser.HTMLParser().feed(open(...).read())' does not raise. One branch, one PR, evidence in the PR body.
